inputs.question: How many customers are from Brazil?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country='Brazil'

inputs.question: How many tracks are longer than 10 minutes?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 600000

inputs.question: What is the title of the album with AlbumId 100?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT Title FROM Album WHERE AlbumId=100

inputs.question: How many employees report directly to the General Manager?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo=(SELECT EmployeeId FROM Employee WHERE Title='General Manager')

inputs.question: In how many different countries do the store's customers live?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) FROM Customer

inputs.question: What is the total of all invoices issued in 2011, rounded to two decimals?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total),2) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y',InvoiceDate)='2011'

inputs.question: Which artist has the most albums in the store, and how many albums do they have?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) c FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar USING(ArtistId) GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.question: Which genre has the most tracks, and how many tracks is that?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) c FROM Track t JOIN Genre g USING(GenreId) GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.question: Which country's customers spent the most in total, and what was that total, rounded to two decimals?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total),2) s FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.question: Which customer has spent the most money in total? Give their full name and the total rounded to two decimals.

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName||' '||c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total),2) s FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c USING(CustomerId) GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.question: Which sales support agent's customers generated the most invoice revenue? Give the agent's full name and the revenue rounded to two decimals.

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName||' '||e.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total),2) s FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c USING(CustomerId) JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId=c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.question: How many tracks are in the playlist named 'Grunge'?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p USING(PlaylistId) WHERE p.Name='Grunge'

inputs.question: What is the average length of a track in the 'Jazz' genre, in whole seconds (rounded down)?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(AVG(Milliseconds)/1000 AS INT) FROM Track JOIN Genre USING(GenreId) WHERE Genre.Name='Jazz'

inputs.question: Which media type has sold the most units (invoice line quantities), and how many units?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) q FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) JOIN MediaType m USING(MediaTypeId) GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.question: Which artist earned the most revenue from track sales, and how much, rounded to two decimals?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity),2) s FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) JOIN Album al USING(AlbumId) JOIN Artist ar USING(ArtistId) GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.question: Which genre brought in the most revenue from customers in the USA, and how much, rounded to two decimals?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity),2) s FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i USING(InvoiceId) JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) JOIN Genre g USING(GenreId) WHERE i.BillingCountry='USA' GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.question: How many tracks have never been sold?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

inputs.question: How many artists have no albums in the store?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM Album)

inputs.question: In which month of 2012 was revenue highest? Give the month as YYYY-MM and the revenue rounded to two decimals.

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',InvoiceDate) m, ROUND(SUM(Total),2) s FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y',InvoiceDate)='2012' GROUP BY m ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.question: Which album has the highest number of distinct customers who bought at least one of its tracks? Give the album title and that number of customers.

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT al.Title, COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) c FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i USING(InvoiceId) JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) JOIN Album al USING(AlbumId) GROUP BY al.AlbumId ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.question: How many customers have bought tracks from at least 10 different genres?

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i.CustomerId FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i USING(InvoiceId) JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) GROUP BY i.CustomerId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) >= 10)

inputs.question: What share of all invoice revenue came from customers in Germany, France and the United Kingdom combined? Give the percentage rounded to one decimal.

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN BillingCountry IN ('Germany','France','United Kingdom') THEN Total ELSE 0 END)/SUM(Total),1) FROM Invoice

inputs.question: Not counting the General Manager, which employee has the most people reporting to them, directly or through others? Give their full name.

reference_outputs.gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(boss, emp) AS (SELECT ReportsTo, EmployeeId FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.ReportsTo, r.emp FROM Employee e JOIN r ON e.EmployeeId=r.boss WHERE e.ReportsTo IS NOT NULL) SELECT e.FirstName||' '||e.LastName FROM r JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId=r.boss WHERE e.Title <> 'General Manager' GROUP BY r.boss ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.question: Which playlist contains the most tracks from the 'Rock' genre, and how many Rock tracks does it contain? Count each track once.

reference_outputs.gold_sql: SELECT p.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) c FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p USING(PlaylistId) JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) JOIN Genre g USING(GenreId) WHERE g.Name='Rock' GROUP BY p.PlaylistId ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1
